en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street scene in the city of Pécs. A large, monumental brick building with stone base and ornate roof dominates the view; in front of it stands a war memorial. A tramcar and several early‑ to mid‑20th‑century automobiles are on the street, and pedestrians walk around the square. Trees and a church tower with a tall spire are visible to the left. The caption beneath the image is in Hungarian. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, an address to Budapest, a Hungarian postage stamp and the printer's imprint.
